responsibility: Implements the shared C-family attribute subsystem for declarations, types, and expressions. This file defines and registers handlers for the large set of GNU and GCC-specific attributes used by C, C++, and Objective-C, validates where they may appear, applies their semantic effects to tree nodes, emits attribute diagnostics, and supports attribute introspection helpers such as __builtin_has_attribute when attributes are represented either in attribute lists or directly in node flags.
